To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the generalized panel data switching regression model provides an excellent fit to the data, 2) the estimated switching regression models are consistent with the hypothesis that the utilities in the sample operate under a single regulatory framework, and 3) the estimated switching regressions models are not consistent with the hypothesis of the existence of scope economies for electric utilities in the sample.

(1) the generalized panel data switching regression model is a useful tool in empirical research, and (2) scope economies are present for publicly owned electric utilities, and the scope economy increases with the size of the utility.
The proposed method is a generalization of the existing switching regression model.
